selection_policy: Use evidence matching hardware, workload, implementation and measured domain; preserve H800 and H100 separately; unmeasured H100 regimes remain uncalibrated.

limitations: Historical GDN has 32 heads and unrecorded CP implementation; historical GDN CP16 is unmeasured

H100.time_scope: Full attention module F+B including CP communication; excludes MLP, optimizer, parameter gradient reduction and cross-layout conversion
H100.runtime_model_status: Solver-loadable partial calibration: separate GQA/GDN CP8/16/32 anchors; GDN32 pools all ten values; whole-plan predictions remain unvalidated
H100.fallback_policy: No H800 substitution: explicit useful-work shape scaling and constant CP8 per-GPU efficiency for CP1/2/4; selected profile bounds measured CP (16 or 32); MLP/head/routes/update/memory analytic and uncalibrated

evaluation.latency_only: secondary metric; not resource-normalized performance gain
evaluation.whole_plan: Use all allocated GPUs and full useful input work; include idle time and online planning/switching
evaluation.absolute_MFU: Requires declared useful-FLOP accounting and matching per-GPU peak; no invented absolute MFU
